homography.note: Homography computation requires surveyed fiducial points on a validated planar ground surface.

distance_estimation.description: Distances estimated from model bounding box geometry. NOT surveyed ground truth.
distance_estimation.note: Model-estimated distances must be labeled MODEL_ESTIMATE in all outputs.

effect_on_model_h.note: Model H distance penalty uses max(0, d-4) hinge. Distance values are model estimates, not surveyed.

governance.rule: Geometry metrics from model estimations must be labeled MODEL_ESTIMATE, not surveyed ground truth.
